en_US: That sparkling new Pokétch!
Your awkwardness as a traveler!
Hmm... You’re still a pretty new
Trainer, aren’t you?
But it’s all good! You’re a new fellow
friend of Pokémon!
So, let me make a gift of this Hidden
Machine to you!
That Hidden Machine, or HM for short,
contains the hidden move Rock Smash.
A Pokémon learning Rock Smash can
smash small boulders in the field.
But the Trainer has to have
the Gym Badge from Oreburgh City.
If you don’t have that Badge, you
can’t make a Pokémon use the hidden
move Rock Smash outside of battle.
Oh! Good golly!
That’s Oreburgh City’s Gym Badge!
All right! Now you can use the hidden
move Rock Smash on small boulders!
I’m the Ground-type Master!
I aim to find the ultimate Ground-type!
Come at me with only a {COLOR 1}single Pokémon{COLOR 0}
in your party if you want to battle me.
Oh, and there’s one other condition...
That Pokémon must be a {COLOR 1}Ground-type{COLOR 0}!
Your Ground-type looks pretty strong!
Should we find out who has the
ultimate Ground-type Pokémon?
Oh, wow.
It seems the ultimate Ground-type
Pokémon belongs to you!
That means you are the rightful owner
of this precious item!
The ultimate Ground-type Pokémon
belongs to me!
But I’m always ready for another
Ground-type battle.
Thank you for a great Ground-type
Pokémon battle.
Hmm...
Do you feel like you can’t win?
